Definition: from G3696; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)):--arm self.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, hoplízō means to arm oneself. It occurs just once, in 1 Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hoplízō as it stands — to arm oneself — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
